## FAQs

What services does Mavis offer?

Mavis provides complete tire services, oil changes, brakes, alignments, and general automotive
repair across more than 2,100 locations. We carry all major tire brands, perform
manufacturer-recommended maintenance, and offer same-day appointments at most stores. [Browse all of
our tire and auto services here][97].

Why are Mavis prices often lower than competitors?

Mavis buys tires at national scale, which allows us to secure better pricing from manufacturers and
pass those savings directly to customers. We constantly move tires across our national network, so
you get same-day or next-day installation at most locations. Our goal is transparent, everyday low
prices on high-quality tires and services.

What tire brands does Mavis carry?

We stock top brands, including Michelin, Goodyear, Firestone, Bridgestone, Continental, Pirelli,
Cooper, Kumho, General, Toyo, Uniroyal, and many Original Equipment (OE) tires. Thousands of models
are available for cars, trucks, SUVs, EVs, and specialty vehicles, and available for same-day
installation at most stores.

Can I buy tires online from Mavis?

Yes. You can shop thousands of tire models and brands on our website, compare prices, and reserve
your tires online. Most tires are available for same-day or next-day installation at your local
Mavis store, and you can schedule your appointment during checkout.

Are Mavis technicians trained and certified?

Yes. Our technicians receive ongoing training and hands-on support through a national Coaching and
Development Team that helps maintain consistent service standards across locations. Many team
members also participate in continuing education and certification or licensing programs, including
state inspection licensing where it is required. This approach helps us make sure that your vehicles
are serviced correctly, safely, and in line with current best practices.

Does Mavis offer warranties on tires and services?

Yes. Most tires include manufacturer warranties, and Mavis offers additional service warranties
depending on the work performed. See our [warranty policy][98] for full details.

Does Mavis accept walk-ins, or do I need an appointment?

You can visit any Mavis location without an appointment, and we’ll fit you in as soon as possible.
For faster service, [online scheduling][99] lets you reserve a time for your tire or auto service.

How do I schedule a service appointment?

Select “Schedule Service” anywhere on the website to open our appointment panel, or [click here to
schedule your appointment][100]. Choose your vehicle, service, and your preferred location, and your
booking will be confirmed instantly.

How many locations does Mavis have?

Mavis and its family of brands operate more than 2,100 service centers across 36 states, with over
3,500 total owned and franchised locations nationwide. Our expanding footprint makes it easy to find
a store near you.

What brands are part of the Mavis family of companies?

Mavis includes several well-known automotive and tire service brands such as Tire Kingdom, NTB,
Express Oil Change & Tire Engineers, Brakes Plus, Mavis Tires & Brakes, Mavis Discount Tire, Town
Fair Tire, Tuffy Tire & Auto Service, and Midas. Across our family of brands, customers benefit from
consistent service, nationwide coverage, and access to thousands of tire and automotive service
options.

When do I pay for my tires or service?

Payment is made in-store after your service is completed. Some online tire orders may require a
small deposit during checkout.

## FAQs

What services does Mavis offer?

Mavis provides complete tire services, oil changes, brakes, alignments, and general automotive
repair across more than 2,100 locations. We carry all major tire brands, perform
manufacturer-recommended maintenance, and offer same-day appointments at most stores. [Browse all of
our tire and auto services here][97].

Why are Mavis prices often lower than competitors?

Mavis buys tires at national scale, which allows us to secure better pricing from manufacturers and
pass those savings directly to customers. We constantly move tires across our national network, so
you get same-day or next-day installation at most locations. Our goal is transparent, everyday low
prices on high-quality tires and services.

What tire brands does Mavis carry?

We stock top brands, including Michelin, Goodyear, Firestone, Bridgestone, Continental, Pirelli,
Cooper, Kumho, General, Toyo, Uniroyal, and many Original Equipment (OE) tires. Thousands of models
are available for cars, trucks, SUVs, EVs, and specialty vehicles, and available for same-day
installation at most stores.

Can I buy tires online from Mavis?

Yes. You can shop thousands of tire models and brands on our website, compare prices, and reserve
your tires online. Most tires are available for same-day or next-day installation at your local
Mavis store, and you can schedule your appointment during checkout.

Are Mavis technicians trained and certified?

Yes. Our technicians receive ongoing training and hands-on support through a national Coaching and
Development Team that helps maintain consistent service standards across locations. Many team
members also participate in continuing education and certification or licensing programs, including
state inspection licensing where it is required. This approach helps us make sure that your vehicles
are serviced correctly, safely, and in line with current best practices.

Does Mavis offer warranties on tires and services?

Yes. Most tires include manufacturer warranties, and Mavis offers additional service warranties
depending on the work performed. See our [warranty policy][98] for full details.

Does Mavis accept walk-ins, or do I need an appointment?

You can visit any Mavis location without an appointment, and we’ll fit you in as soon as possible.
For faster service, [online scheduling][99] lets you reserve a time for your tire or auto service.

How do I schedule a service appointment?

Select “Schedule Service” anywhere on the website to open our appointment panel, or [click here to
schedule your appointment][100]. Choose your vehicle, service, and your preferred location, and your
booking will be confirmed instantly.

How many locations does Mavis have?

Mavis and its family of brands operate more than 2,100 service centers across 36 states, with over
3,500 total owned and franchised locations nationwide. Our expanding footprint makes it easy to find
a store near you.

What brands are part of the Mavis family of companies?

Mavis includes several well-known automotive and tire service brands such as Tire Kingdom, NTB,
Express Oil Change & Tire Engineers, Brakes Plus, Mavis Tires & Brakes, Mavis Discount Tire, Town
Fair Tire, Tuffy Tire & Auto Service, and Midas. Across our family of brands, customers benefit from
consistent service, nationwide coverage, and access to thousands of tire and automotive service
options.

When do I pay for my tires or service?

Payment is made in-store after your service is completed. Some online tire orders may require a
small deposit during checkout.

Tire Kingdom was founded in 1972 by Chuck Curcio in a small farmer’s market stall in West Palm

know-how, the brand quickly expanded across the state and earned a reputation for fast, dependable
auto care. In 2023, Tire Kingdom was acquired by Mavis Tire.

[More About Mavis][89]

Throughout the 1980s and 1990s, Tire Kingdom expanded beyond Florida, with stores opening in
Georgia, Louisiana, the Carolinas, and even as far as New Hampshire and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The
brand changed hands several times - first acquired by Michelin in 1989, then sold to an investment
group led by Goldman Sachs in 1993, before being purchased by TBC Corporation in 2000. Under TBC,
the brand continued to grow until a 2015 realignment rebranded many out-of-state Tire Kingdom stores
under the NTB name, with the Tire Kingdom name remaining focused primarily on its Florida roots.



### **Tire Kingdom Joins Mavis Tire**

In June 2023, Mavis Tire acquired the Tire Kingdom brand from TBC Corporation, including over 200
company-operated locations. Today, Tire Kingdom is fully owned and operated by Mavis Tire,

passenger and light truck tire portfolios of Goodyear and Bridgestone. We’re out to set a new

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are the best fleet tire pressure management options?

The best fleet tire pressure management options include Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems (TPMS),
[auto-tire inflation systems][57], and regular manual inspections. These solutions ensure tires
remain at optimal pressure, enhancing safety, performance, and fuel efficiency.

How can my fleet’s tires be managed better?

Fleet tires can be managed better by implementing TPMS and auto-tire inflation systems, conducting
regular inspections, and maintaining proper tire rotation schedules. Using [fleet tire management
software][58] to track tire health data and trends can also aid proactive maintenance and timely
replacements. Training drivers on the importance of tire care further enhances overall tire
management.

Does truck tire pressure affect fuel economy?

Yes, truck tire pressure significantly affects fuel economy. Properly inflated tires reduce rolling
resistance, allowing the engine to operate more efficiently and consume less fuel. According to
industry studies, maintaining optimal tire pressure can lead to [fuel savings][59] of up to 1.4%,
which is substantial for fleets covering long distances.

How can I lower fleet operating costs?

Lowering fleet operating costs can be achieved by implementing technologies such as TPMS and
[auto-tire inflation systems][60] to maintain optimal tire pressure, thus improving fuel efficiency
and extending tire life. Regular vehicle maintenance and driver training on fuel-efficient
practices, combined with data analytics, optimize maintenance schedules and lead to significant cost
savings.

What is a Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS)?

TPMS is a system designed to monitor the air pressure inside pneumatic tires on vehicles, providing
real-time information to the driver.

How does TPMS help in fleet management?

TPMS helps fleet managers ensure that tires are always properly inflated, which improves fuel
efficiency, enhances safety, and reduces tire wear and maintenance costs.

What are the main benefits of using TPMS in trucks?

The main benefits include increased fuel efficiency, extended tire lifespan, improved safety, and
reduced risk of tire blowouts.

Can TPMS prevent tire blowouts?

While TPMS can’t prevent blowouts directly, it can [significantly reduce the risk][61] by alerting
drivers to potential issues before they become critical.

What should fleet managers consider when selecting a TPMS for their fleet?

Factors to consider include the system’s reliability, ease of installation and use, compatibility
with existing fleet technology, and the quality of customer support.

Are there different types of TPMS?

Yes, there are direct and indirect TPMS. Direct TPMS measures air pressure directly from the tire,
while indirect TPMS estimates pressure by monitoring wheel speed and other vehicle data.

How does maintaining proper tire pressure improve fuel efficiency?

Properly inflated tires have lower rolling resistance, which means the engine doesn’t have to work
as hard, leading to improved fuel efficiency.

How can TPMS data be integrated into fleet management software?

Many modern TPMS solutions offer integration capabilities with fleet management software, allowing
for real-time monitoring and analysis of tire pressure data across the fleet. [Halo Connect i3][62]
is an intelligent automatic tire inflation system with integrated sensors allowing for seamless data
collection and reporting.

What maintenance is required for TPMS sensors?

[TPMS sensors][63] generally require minimal maintenance, but they should be checked periodically
for battery life and replaced as needed to ensure they remain functional.

## GROUP OVERVIEW

# BKT Group identity

BKT is a global industrial group with a strong manufacturing foundation and a diversified business
portfolio.

Our activities span tire solutions for complex mobility needs, from agricultural and industrial
applications to everyday transportation, as well as carbon black production serving a wide range of
industries.

Across geographies and markets, we operate through integrated processes, consistent quality
standards and a governance model designed to sustain growth over time.

[ Explore who we are ][79]

## BKT SOLUTIONS

## Tire solutions across applications

BKT designs tire solutions for people and industries operating across a wide range of applications,
from heavy duty environments to everyday mobility. Each product range is engineered to deliver
reliability, performance and consistency in real operating conditions.

[

## CARBON BLACK

Your success, our priority.

Carbon black is a strategic industrial material used across a wide range of applications beyond tire
manufacturing. BKT produces carbon black through advanced, vertically integrated processes focused
on quality, efficiency, and long-term performance, supporting multiple industrial sectors worldwide.

[ Visit Carbon Black ][83]

### SUSTAINABILITY

Sustainability as an industrial system

At BKT, sustainability is embedded into the way the Group designs products, manages operations, and
governs its value chain. A disciplined and measurable approach supports long term performance,
operational resilience, and responsible growth across markets.

[ Explore Sustainability ][84]

### BKT SPORTS

Powering sports around the world

Sport is a powerful expression of commitment, performance, and shared ambition. Through global
partnerships and long term sponsorships, BKT supports disciplines that reflect the same values
guiding our business every day, dedication, reliability, and the pursuit of excellence.

[ Explore BKT Sponsorship ][85]

### PEOPLE

People behind progress

Behind every product, process, and partnership, there are people. At BKT, we foster a culture built
on responsibility, development, and long term commitment, creating an environment where skills grow
and shared values guide our progress.

## More about Continental Tires

#### **Our Company**

Tires are the decisive point of contact between the vehicle and the road. Care, precision, and
efficiency have made us one of the world’s leading tire manufacturers.

[Read more][189]

[alt]

#### Sustainability

Continental is convinced that sustainable and responsible business increases our ability to innovate
and meet the future – adding value to the company. It allows us to identify risks and opportunities
early and opens up the change processes we need. This is why sustainability is firmly integrated in
our corporate strategy and is a key driver of innovation.

[Read more][190]

[alt]

#### Technology & Innovation

Tires are our passion. For 150 years, our technological excellence has ensured safety. All vehicles
benefit from the technological progress of our tires, regardless of their drive system. That's how
we drive the mobility of the future.

[Read more][191]

[alt]

## More about Continental Tires

#### **Our Company**

Tires are the decisive point of contact between the vehicle and the road. Care, precision, and
efficiency have made us one of the world’s leading tire manufacturers.

[Read more][189]

[alt]

#### Sustainability

Continental is convinced that sustainable and responsible business increases our ability to innovate
and meet the future – adding value to the company. It allows us to identify risks and opportunities
early and opens up the change processes we need. This is why sustainability is firmly integrated in
our corporate strategy and is a key driver of innovation.

[Read more][190]

[alt]

#### Technology & Innovation

Tires are our passion. For 150 years, our technological excellence has ensured safety. All vehicles
benefit from the technological progress of our tires, regardless of their drive system. That's how
we drive the mobility of the future.

[Read more][191]

[alt]

### How We Win

Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, and established in 1898, Goodyear is one of the world’s most
recognized and respected brands in the world.

Committed to being #1 in Tires and Service, now and in the future through technology and innovation,
Goodyear is annually recognized as a top place to work with about 68,000 dedicated associates - all
working hard to deliver the highest quality in everything that we do.

[ Discover Goodyear ][88]

### Committed to Helping Build a Better Future

### Our Framework

The Better Future Framework outlines our high-priority sustainability topics.

### Our Pillars

The Framework’s Pillars guide our sustainability strategy and work.

### Our High-Priority Topics

Our High-Priority Topics focus on the areas that matter most to our internal and external
stakeholders.

### Our Goals

Our Goals allow us to measure our progress along our sustainability journey.

Goodyear’s innovative spirit and drive for excellence powers our ability to deliver the best tires

Arlington’s AT&T Stadium. Organizers say the move reflects the region’s growing pull for cultural
and sports programming and a chance to put HBCU marching bands’ artistry, scholarship funding and
decades of tradition in front of the region’s business and alumni networks.

publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

**Never losing sight of where we came from. ** Always pondering a better way. Making sure we
continue to grow. Our business partners continue to profit. And their customers continue to be safer
on the road.

Giti Tire replaced petroleum-based ingredients with nature-derived alternatives such as sustainable
natural rubber, pine resin, rice husk silica, and plant-based antioxidants.

compound to boost grip and driving confidence.

life, extending performance and reliability.

Extracted from rice husks, this natural silica replaces traditional quartz and helps lower rolling
resistance while improving wet traction.

Giti Tire replaced petroleum-based ingredients with nature-derived alternatives such as sustainable

compound to boost grip and driving confidence.

This petroleum-free solution is used across the tire to help preserve rubber quality throughout its
life, extending performance and reliability.

Extracted from rice husks, this natural silica replaces traditional quartz and helps lower rolling
resistance while improving wet traction.

# Enterprise Tire, Auto, & Lube Business Software

[Retail Shop Software][9] [Tire Distributor Software][10]
[Computer]
Products

## HITS^{™} BPOS
* Point-of-Sale
* Shop Management
* Inventory Management

HITS BPOS is our comprehensive and easy to use cloud-based point-of-sale software. BPOS is used by
retail tire and auto shops, commercial tire businesses, and wholesale tire distributors.

BPOS has been built for speed and efficiency. BPOS streamlines point-of-sale processes and helps you
and your staff manage your shop.

BPOS contains modern sales tools, a top-rated appointment and scheduling system, rock-solid
inventory management, accurate reporting, enterprise-based accounts receivable, accounting/ERP
integrations, and tie-ins to popular third-party tire and auto service business tools.

[..Product Videos For Retail Tire & Auto Shops][11] [..Product Videos For Wholesale Tire
Distributors][12]
[Image]

Intuitive screens with simple navigation. Software comes with unlimited online training courses, an
installation guide, and a dedicated project manager.

[Image]

Simple and integrated point-of-sale functionality including integrated payments and signature
capture.

[Image]

Loaded with tire-selling and management tools. Optional tire catalog, tire supplier integrations,
and simple drive-out pricing tools.

[Image]

Built on a robust inventory management platform. Easily track and audit stocking inventory.
Streamline outside purchase payables and returns.

[Image]

Manage your workload and shop schedule with drag-and-drop scheduling and online integrated
appointments.

[Image]

An extensive report library helps you track important business metrics, inventory, accounts
receivable, and employee activity.

## HITS^{™} SERVICECAT + LUBECAT
* Part & Labor Estimating
* Parts Ordering
* Quick Lube Module
* BPOS Add-On

HITS ServiceCAT is a lightning-fast parts and labor estimating add-on to the HITS BPOS software.
ServiceCAT is used by tire shops, auto service centers, and quick lube businesses.

ServiceCAT allows for multi-vendor part lookup and ordering, unlimited local inventory setup, labor
guide, ands service intervals, as well as the LubeCAT quick lube module.

ServiceCAT comes pre-configured with 200+ job groups, so your shop can create estimates and
invoices, and order parts without complicated configuration.

ServiceCAT requires an EPICOR data license.

[..Product Videos For Retail Tire, Auto, & Lube Shops][13]
[Image]

Service quotes in under 20 seconds. No need to call the customer back, book the service job with
them *now!*

[Image]

Comes pre-configured with 200+ jobs. No need to go through the laborious process of setting up
static canned jobs.

[Image]

All your part vendors in one place for vehicle-specific part lookup and integrated part ordering.
Seamless workflow with HITS BPOS.

[Image]

Manage part inventories and quote jobs using your shop's in-house part inventory.

[Image]

Integrated Mitchell Labor guide and service intervals.

[Image]

Streamlined quick lube module with automated adders and oil change sticker printing.

## HITS^{™} Tirelink
* Real-Time E-Commerce Platform
* B2B Ordering
* BPOS Add-On

HITS Tirelink is a real-time B2B e-commerce add-on to the HITS BPOS Software. Tirelink is used
primarily by regional tire wholesalers as well as large retail tire shops that do local wholesaling
of tires.

Tirelink connects to the HITS BPOS software in real-time, so inventory, pricing, and customer
accounts are always accurate to the minute. Orders placed on the Tirelink e-commerce platform
populate and allocate inventory in the HITS BPOS software.

For HITS BPOS users interested in B2C e-commerce, BPOS is integrated with Tire Connect.

[..Product Videos For Wholesale Tire Distributors][14]
[Image]

Easy to use business-to-business e-commerce that connects your customers to your inventory and their
account.

[Image]

Integrated in real-time to the HITS BPOS system. Customer, account, and inventory edits are
reflected in Tirelink immediately.

[Image]

Optional tire catalog provides important images, specifications, and selling features.

[Image]

Boost sales for other products types like wheels, tubes, and accessories.

[Image]

Tirelink is responsive for tablet and mobile devices so your customers can order easily from
anywhere.

[Image]

Allow your customers to easily create quotes for their customer directly on your Tirelink e-commerce
site.

[Image]

Online orders immediately transfer into the HITS BPOS system. Order can be set to automatically
relieve inventory or pending-review.

Customers Say...

“I want to win the salesman of the year award for recommending your software! As we continue to grow
our franchise, we are happy to have the best system on the market in place.” -Stuart, Tire Centers

distributor programs along with lucrative volume bonus and dividend programs. Members of ITDG
harness the buying power of 1,500+ locations while fully maintaining their identity, independence,
and flexibility.

With locations in 50 states, our members and shareholders benefit from 30 years of continuous growth
and share in the substantial profits earned each and every year. Helping to level the playing field
for the independent dealer is our top priority and we do so by leveraging our buying power into
favorable pricing and strategic partnerships with some of the world’s best known manufacturers and
distributors.

[Learn More][14]

Good programs produce good results, and the ITDG program has continued to grow each and every year
since its inception in 1994. The group has more than tripled its geographic footprint and purchase
volume over the last 10 years with its highly competitive **member owned** and **profit driven**
model.

According to an article in the NIA’s (National Insulation Association’s) “Insulation Outlook®”

the weight of a heavy car! ) Even so, a small industrial tank 30ft diameter X 20ft tall, subject to
a mere 10-degree F temperature difference and insulated with 1inch of R6 polyisocyanurate insulation
will save 388 BTU/yr. For a 20-degree F difference, the insulation saves 776 BTU/yr. **More than
twice the greenness of a tree!** Of all the technology at our disposal, insulation is the most
cost-effective tool we have for saving energy and reducing our carbon impact on the environment. Few
energy related technologies can come close to the rapid R.O.I. offered by insulation. *According to
the NIA: “A properly designed, specified, installed, and maintained insulation system is an
investment with high and rapid returns – paybacks are often less than 6 months.”*

###### National Tyre & Wheel Pty Ltd

# Driving Performance Across Australia

National Tyre & Wheel connects leading tyre brands with retailers across Australia, delivering
quality, performance, and reliability for all vehicles—from passenger cars to heavy-duty
applications.

[ Explore Brands ][87]
[ Explore Categories ][88]

#### Your trusted partner for quality tyres and wheels across Australia

National Tyre & Wheel is a trusted name in tyre distribution, supplying high-quality products to
tyre retailers, fleets, councils, and businesses across Australia. With an extensive range and
strong brand partnerships, we provide reliable supply and expert support to keep vehicles moving.

## Trusted by Australia's top tyre retailers

## Explore Our Tyre Categories

We offer a wide range of tyres, from passenger vehicles to heavy-duty equipment, making it easy for
you to meet the needs of your customers.

[

#### 4WD Tyres

Explore our 4x4 tyres, built for trusted traction, strength, and comfort.
][89]
[

#### Truck & Bus Tyres

Browse our truck and bus tyres, designed for strength, durability, and lasting performance.
][90]
[

#### Agricultural Tyres

View our agricultural tyres, made for strength, traction, and reliable field performance.
][91]
[ Discover More ][92]

## About National Tyre & Wheel

National Tyre & Wheel is a leading distributor of tyres and wheels nationwide, supplying a broad
range of products through a network of trusted retailers and partners. Our focus is on quality,
consistency, and long-term relationships—with brands, businesses, and the people behind them.

We support a wide range of industries, from retail and transport to agriculture and industrial
operations, backed by efficient logistics and decades of experience in the trade.

[ Learn More ][93]

## The Advantage of Partnering with NTAW

Working with the right supplier makes a difference. National Tyre & Wheel provides more than just
access to leading tyre brands—we deliver the support, reliability, and expertise to help businesses
operate with confidence.
* Strong Supply Network – Consistent product availability and efficient nationwide distribution.
* Wide Brand Selection – Access to globally recognised and specialist tyre brands.
* Industry Expertise – Decades of experience supporting retailers, fleets, and commercial
  operations.
* Dedicated Support – A team that understands your needs and helps you find the right fit.

 

With NTAW, you’re backed by a supplier that values long-term partnerships and delivers where it
matters.

[ Learn More ][94]
"Working with National Tyre and Wheel has transformed our business. Their reliability and extensive
product range make them our go-to supplier."
John Doe
Owner

## Join Our Wholesale Network Today

Gain access to leading tyre brands, reliable supply, and expert support by partnering with NTAW.
Contact us today to learn more about joining our wholesale network.

[ Learn More ][95]

# Driving Performance Across Australia

National Tyre & Wheel connects leading tyre brands with retailers across Australia, delivering
quality, performance, and reliability for all vehicles—from passenger cars to heavy-duty
applications.

[ Explore Brands ][87]
[ Explore Categories ][88]

#### Your trusted partner for quality tyres and wheels across Australia

National Tyre & Wheel is a trusted name in tyre distribution, supplying high-quality products to
tyre retailers, fleets, councils, and businesses across Australia. With an extensive range and
strong brand partnerships, we provide reliable supply and expert support to keep vehicles moving.

## Trusted by Australia's top tyre retailers

## Explore Our Tyre Categories

We offer a wide range of tyres, from passenger vehicles to heavy-duty equipment, making it easy for
you to meet the needs of your customers.

## About National Tyre & Wheel

National Tyre & Wheel is a leading distributor of tyres and wheels nationwide, supplying a broad
range of products through a network of trusted retailers and partners. Our focus is on quality,
consistency, and long-term relationships—with brands, businesses, and the people behind them.

We support a wide range of industries, from retail and transport to agriculture and industrial
operations, backed by efficient logistics and decades of experience in the trade.

[ Learn More ][93]

## The Advantage of Partnering with NTAW

Working with the right supplier makes a difference. National Tyre & Wheel provides more than just
access to leading tyre brands—we deliver the support, reliability, and expertise to help businesses
operate with confidence.
* Strong Supply Network – Consistent product availability and efficient nationwide distribution.
* Wide Brand Selection – Access to globally recognised and specialist tyre brands.
* Industry Expertise – Decades of experience supporting retailers, fleets, and commercial
  operations.
* Dedicated Support – A team that understands your needs and helps you find the right fit.

 

With NTAW, you’re backed by a supplier that values long-term partnerships and delivers where it
matters.

нового опыта в различных областях. С помощью нашего программного обеспечения вы сможете приобрести

геймификации. Сервисы созданы настоящими профессионалами своего дела - ведущими специалистами из

Agenda

#### What to Expect


Thought-Provoking Sessions

Gain valuable insights from renowned international speakers. Delve into key trends, strategies, and
predictions  reshaping the industry landscape.

Startup Innovation Showcase

Witness the groundbreaking ideas that are redefining retail, straight from Israel's back yard of
innovation.

Intimate roundtables &  Workshops

Dive deep into interactive workshops led by experts in the field and discover how they're
revolutionizing the retail sector.


Experience the Startup Nation

Immerse yourself in the vibrant ecosystem of Tel Aviv, often referred to as the Startup Nation. 

Curated 1:1 meetings

Connect with industry leaders, forward-thinking retailers, and visionary startup founders from
across the globe.

[Tomer Foltyn 2018_10_29 Retail Disrupt 028.jpg]
Why attend

#  Why Attend

For the first time, you can exclusively join us to uncover, learn, and network with the entire
retail tech ecosystem from the convenience of your home - no travel required!

Communicate with customers across chats, email, and phone, with every conversation stored in one

visits.

## AI Tools [AI]

Reduce routine work by up to 80% with built-in AI

### Call and voice message transcription

Automatically turn calls and voice messages into text with summaries and sentiment insights, so you
never miss important details.

### Product recognition by image & background removal

Take a photo in RO Mobile App, and AI instantly creates a catalogue-ready product with a suggested
name, description, and clean background.

### AI-assisted product imports from supplier files

Upload Excel files and let AI recognise the structure and content to import large product lists
without manual work.

### Suggested replies in customer chats

AI analyses conversations and suggests ready-to-use replies to help you respond faster and more
consistently.

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

## Our Core Capabilities

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]
[Trend research illustration showing forecasting and data analysis]

## Thematic and Disruption Research

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

[Read More about Thematic and Disruption Research][51]
[Thematic and Disruption Research]

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

[Read More about Strategic Revenue Advisory][52]
[Strategic Revenue Advisory]

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

## Ready to turn market uncertainty into revenue clarity

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

Tire Guru is a comprehensive solution built specifically for the tire industry. In addition to
software, we also offer websites and marketing services to help you stand out and boost profits. Get
everything you need in one place and ditch the hassle of juggling multiple providers.

[Learn More][31]

# BUILT TO FIT YOUR SPECIFIC BUSINESS NEEDS

We understand the unique needs of the tire and auto repair industry. Tire Guru provides an
all-in-one solution for tire shops, auto repair shops, mobile van operators, and wholesale
warehouses. We are with you every step of the way.

[Learn More][32]

Tailored to the unique needs of the tire industry, Tire Guru is here to help streamline workflows.
Each part of our software comes with robust features to help automate common tasks, simplify
scheduling, and save your team time.

[Learn More][33]

## Software

Intelligent shop management software built specifically for the tire industry. Automate workflows to
streamline your operations and save time. Smart features enable you to boost customer satisfaction
and increase profits to grow your business.

[Learn More ][34]

## Websites and Digital Marketing

Let us help support your marketing efforts so you can save time and stay one step ahead of the
competition. Custom-built, industry tailored websites drive more business to your shop; SEO and paid
ads will increase your reach and brand awareness.

[Learn More ][35]

## Customer Marketing and Communication

Happy, loyal customers are essential to a high-functioning business. Tire Guru’s customer marketing
features make this easy. Proactively communicate with customers via two-way texting, drive repeat
business with effective email and text marketing campaigns, offer loyalty rewards, and effortlessly
gain more positive reviews.

[Learn More ][36]

## THE CUSTOMER JOURNEY

## 1.

##### CUSTOMER SCHEDULES

Customer searches for tires on the integrated website, schedules an appointment for installation and
pays for the tires online

## 2.

##### CUSTOMER NOTIFIED

Customer is reminded of appointment via text message and upon dropping off their vehicle, receives
automated status texts

## 3.

##### INSPECTION PERFORMED

The store performs a digital inspection and sends the customer portal link where they can view
inspection results

## 4.

##### TEXT-TO-PAY SENT

The customer approves additional recommended services in the customer portal & receives a
Text-to-Pay link for payment

## 5.

##### WORK IS COMPLETED

The customer is notified of completion of services via automated text. The invoice is then emailed
to the customer

## 6.

##### CUSTOMER FOLLOW-UP

The customer receives a text prompting them to leave a review. 6 months later they are reminded to
come in for a tire rotation by text or email

Why Our Brands Win

## Proprietary Brands Designed for Dealer Success

Turbo Wholesale Tire creates category-leading brands that drive dealer profitability. Lexani,
Rolling Big Power, and Lionhart are three of the industry’s fastest-growing proprietary lines that
are engineered to outperform competitors, with 247 new sizes and types added since 2023 and
exclusive margin protections through our first-to-market dealer programs. Unlike commoditized
distributors, we protect your investment through selective distribution, ensuring your market
remains uncrowded and your margins stay strong.

Manufacturing Excellence

## Engineered for Performance,
## Built for Profit

From concept to customer, we control every aspect of our tire development and production. Our
state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and rigorous quality control ensure every Lexani, RBP, and
Lionhart tire meets the highest industry standards. With direct oversight of the entire production
process, we deliver consistent quality, innovative designs, and rapid time-to-market for new sizes
and specialty fitments. This manufacturing expertise allows us to respond quickly to market demands
while maintaining the premium standards dealers and consumers expect.

[rolling shot of white subaru wrx with lionhart ramani all season tires by ocean with battleship in
background]

Dealer Advantages

## Why Dealers Choose Our Brands

As the exclusive manufacturer of Lexani, RBP, and Lionhart, we offer dealers what commodity tire
companies cannot: guaranteed margins, protected territories, and direct manufacturer support. Our
commitment to excellence has earned the trust of thousands of dealers nationwide who consistently
praise our extensive inventory, competitive pricing, and reliable delivery. Our dealer programs
provides exclusive access to new products, marketing support, and volume incentives. Because we
control every aspect of production and distribution, we deliver consistency, quality, and
profitability that keeps your customers coming back.

BRAND LEGACY

## From Distributor to Disruptor: 40+ Years of Innovation

Since 1983, Turbo Wholesale Tires has evolved from a regional supplier into a proprietary brand
powerhouse. Our transformation reflects a relentless commitment to innovation, quality, and
partnership with independent tire dealers. What began as distribution has evolved into full-scale
manufacturing and brand development, allowing us complete control over product quality, market
positioning, and dealer profitability.

With a 300,000+ square foot flagship facility in Irwindale, CA, and our Product Innovation Center
(PIC) in Southfield, MI driving next-generation tire development, we maintain complete oversight
from concept to delivery across our three proprietary brands. Our leadership team brings hundreds of
combined years of experience from top-tier companies like Goodyear, Pirelli, and Continental. This
expertise fuels our ability to design high-profit, low-complexity programs and protect brand value
through selective distribution and products with unique sizes, types and tread patterns. We don’t
just manufacture tires: we build brands that empower dealers to increase margins and stand out in
their markets.

[ Our Brand Story ][22]

Choose how you receive your Lexani, RBP, and Lionhart inventory: factory direct, warehouse

brands are never overexposed, while our coast-to-coast network delivers faster turnaround than
competitors. As the manufacturer, we guarantee consistent availability and competitive pricing that
protects your investment in our brands.

Why Our Brands Win

## Proprietary Brands Designed for Dealer Success

Turbo Wholesale Tire creates category-leading brands that drive dealer profitability. Lexani,
Rolling Big Power, and Lionhart are three of the industry’s fastest-growing proprietary lines that
are engineered to outperform competitors, with 247 new sizes and types added since 2023 and
exclusive margin protections through our first-to-market dealer programs. Unlike commoditized
distributors, we protect your investment through selective distribution, ensuring your market
remains uncrowded and your margins stay strong.

Manufacturing Excellence

## Engineered for Performance,
## Built for Profit

From concept to customer, we control every aspect of our tire development and production. Our
state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and rigorous quality control ensure every Lexani, RBP, and
Lionhart tire meets the highest industry standards. With direct oversight of the entire production
process, we deliver consistent quality, innovative designs, and rapid time-to-market for new sizes
and specialty fitments. This manufacturing expertise allows us to respond quickly to market demands
while maintaining the premium standards dealers and consumers expect.

[rolling shot of white subaru wrx with lionhart ramani all season tires by ocean with battleship in
background]

Dealer Advantages

## Why Dealers Choose Our Brands

As the exclusive manufacturer of Lexani, RBP, and Lionhart, we offer dealers what commodity tire
companies cannot: guaranteed margins, protected territories, and direct manufacturer support. Our
commitment to excellence has earned the trust of thousands of dealers nationwide who consistently
praise our extensive inventory, competitive pricing, and reliable delivery. Our dealer programs
provides exclusive access to new products, marketing support, and volume incentives. Because we
control every aspect of production and distribution, we deliver consistency, quality, and
profitability that keeps your customers coming back.

BRAND LEGACY

## From Distributor to Disruptor: 40+ Years of Innovation

Since 1983, Turbo Wholesale Tires has evolved from a regional supplier into a proprietary brand
powerhouse. Our transformation reflects a relentless commitment to innovation, quality, and
partnership with independent tire dealers. What began as distribution has evolved into full-scale
manufacturing and brand development, allowing us complete control over product quality, market
positioning, and dealer profitability.

With a 300,000+ square foot flagship facility in Irwindale, CA, and our Product Innovation Center
(PIC) in Southfield, MI driving next-generation tire development, we maintain complete oversight
from concept to delivery across our three proprietary brands. Our leadership team brings hundreds of
combined years of experience from top-tier companies like Goodyear, Pirelli, and Continental. This
expertise fuels our ability to design high-profit, low-complexity programs and protect brand value
through selective distribution and products with unique sizes, types and tread patterns. We don’t
just manufacture tires: we build brands that empower dealers to increase margins and stand out in
their markets.
